value.visualThesis: A friendly, credible B2B agency system for RankForge Kenya: a dark violet photographic hero framing the page top, a long light-neutral body of badge-headed sections with alternating faint lavender surfaces, violet pill CTAs as the only saturated recurring accent, a deliberately tall asymmetric services card collection as the commercial core, narrative splits with floating metric chips, a photo-backed testimonial band, and dark conversion surfaces (newsletter band, near-black contact banner, dense footer) closing the page. Three-family typography (geometric display, structured H2, humanist body) with capitalize heading voice.

signatureTraits.description: Full-bleed ~1.07-viewport hero with a collaborative-workplace photograph under a dark violet wash, carrying the largest display headline on the page and one violet pill CTA.

Header with a centered inline navigation strip (Poppins-style 15px/600 capitalize links) and a distinct violet pill action CTA at the header's right; header compresses and collapses to a compact mobile menu with the CTA still reachable.
Near-full-height light editorial split: large portrait-orientation photo displayed within a soft lavender circular/blob mask on one side, dense multi-bullet copy on the other.

The tallest homepage region (~1.86 viewports) holds an asymmetric services collection: a 4-across icon-card row, then a 2-across wide-card row, then another 4-across row — equal white rounded cards with icon chips and per-card violet pill actions.
Two sequential narrative splits pairing medium imagery with copy and small floating metric-style chips, one image right-aligned, one left-aligned; chips are the focal parallax/reveal elements.

A light FAQ band with flat illustration montage left and violet pill-shaped accordion rows right (first item expanded in dark text, rest as saturated violet pills with trailing chevrons), followed by a photo-backed testimonial band: full-bleed office photograph with white rounded review cards and a dark accent quote card over the left half.
A compact (~0.38 viewport) newsletter band with inline name/email fields, then a dark contact/footer region opening with a near-black full-width contact banner and dense multi-column dark footer.

Systemic rounded-pill violet buttons with small trailing arrow/plus glyphs used for every CTA and per-card action, plus small uppercase pill badges preceding section headings; violet is low-to-mid frequency accent on neutral surfaces; a light trusted-logos strip with reduced-weight marks appears early in the body.

fidelityPriorities: Page silhouette: dark hero → light body sequence → photo mass → dark conversion close; the light/dark surface sequencing is the strongest identity signal
First viewport: full-bleed dark violet photo hero with 60px-class display headline and violet pill CTA
Region topology and proportions: 12-section rhythm including the unusually tall ~1.86-viewport services collection
Violet pill button/badge system as the sole saturated recurring accent
Three-family typography relationships and capitalize heading voice
Photography grammar: workplace-context imagery with dark overlays and masked portrait
Responsive reflow: single-column stacking without content removal
Motion: scroll-reveal based, no structural movement (parallax replaced per Adaptation Contract)

globalGrid.containerLogic: Full-bleed section surfaces with a centered ~1200px content container; gutters 40px desktop / 24px tablet / 20px mobile. The hero and testimonial bands use full-bleed photographic backgrounds with content inside the same container. The services collection uses the standard container but spans ~1.86 viewports vertically across three card rows (4-up, 2-up wide, 4-up). Splits use roughly 45/55 two-column arrangements; the tall collection and splits stack to single column under ~900px.

value.spacingRhythm: Editorial SaaS rhythm: generous section padding (~clamp(80px, 9vw, 140px) top/bottom for major sections), tight internal gaps within card rows (24–32px), compact nav strip (header ~143px desktop incl. nav strip, compressing on mobile). The services collection is intentionally taller than other sections and must not be compressed to normalize rhythm; FAQ and testimonial regions stay at standard scale; newsletter band is deliberately compact (~0.38 viewport).

typographyRoles.description: Figtree 60px/700, 78px line-height, capitalize — hero headline only; scales to ~40px mobile. Fallback: closest rounded-geometric sans if Figtree unavailable.
Montserrat 40px/700, 48px line-height, 0.8px letter-spacing, capitalize — all section headings, typically preceded by a small violet pill badge label.
Figtree 40px/700, 0.8px tracking, capitalize — sub-headings inside splits and card titles, creating a compressed level below H2.
Poppins 16px/400, 22.4px line-height — all paragraph copy; measure ~60–75ch maximum.
Poppins 15px/600, capitalize — navigation links, pill CTA labels, badges and card action buttons.
Poppins 13–14px/400 — footer legal lines, form helper text, chip captions.

colorRoles.description: Light neutral #F9FAFB–#F0F0F0 with occasional faint lavender tints (#F0E0FF) — the majority of the page (~60–65% of visual mass).
Near-black #101010 and dark gray #505050 family frame the page: dark violet hero wash top, near-black contact banner, dark footer bottom (~20–25% of mass).
Saturated violet #8E2DE2 (deep variant #4E2FDA) — CTA fills, pill badges, FAQ pills, icon chips; low-to-mid frequency, concentrated on actionable elements.
Body text #374151 on light surfaces; white on dark surfaces and hero overlay.
White rounded cards over light and photographic surfaces.

value.surfaceLanguage: Flat, friendly SaaS surfaces: no glassmorphism, no heavy gradients, no textured backgrounds. Depth comes from (1) surface shifts between light gray, lavender-tinted, photographic and dark bands; (2) soft subtle shadows on white cards and floating metric chips; (3) the soft lavender circular/blob mask on the about portrait; (4) dark purple overlay wash on photographic hero and darkening overlay on the testimonial backdrop. Radii are pill (999px) for buttons/badges/FAQ rows and ~12px for cards; borders are minimal or absent.
value.headerNavigation: Desktop header ~143px total: top bar with logo left; below it a centered inline navigation strip (~568px, 15px/600 capitalize links) with a violet pill CTA at the header's right ('Request an SEO Consultation'). Header sits over the dark hero as a transparent/light-on-dark bar; becomes solid light on scrolled state. Mobile: header compresses, nav collapses to a compact menu, pill CTA remains reachable in or beside the menu bar.

homepageFirstViewport.summary: First viewport = header (transparent over hero, with centered nav strip and violet pill CTA) + full-bleed dark violet photographic hero (~1.07 viewport heights): collaborative-workplace photo under a dark purple wash (target dominant tone near #301F40–#604070, luminance ~40–66), headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.' in 60px Figtree-class display with supporting copy, primary pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation' and secondary CTA 'Explore Our Services'. Text mass left-weighted; photo texture visible through the wash; the top of the next light section may peek at very tall viewports.

homepageRegions.purpose: Header + full-bleed dark violet photo hero: display headline 'Get found when your customers are already searching.', supporting copy on technical SEO / content strategy / focused execution, primary pill CTA 'Request an SEO Consultation', secondary CTA 'Explore Our Services'.

Near-full-height light editorial split: masked portrait photo in soft lavender blob mask introducing RankForge's approach ('SEO without the noise' spirit), with dense multi-bullet copy on expertise and philosophy; optional small stat-style chips acceptable within the split language.

Light trust strip with centered Montserrat heading and a horizontal row of reduced-weight partner/credential marks. Content constraint: no invented client logos — use generic text-based marks only if the business supplies them; otherwise present the strip as a capability/credential line at reduced visual weight.

Commercial core: very tall (~1.86 viewport) services collection presenting exactly the six RankForge services across an asymmetric card layout — 4-across icon-card row, 2-across wide-card row, 4-across row (cards for SEO Strategy, Technical SEO, Local SEO, SEO Content Strategy, Ecommerce SEO, SEO Audits plus supporting capability cards); white rounded cards, icon chips, per-card violet pill actions.

Narrative split (image right, copy left) with floating metric-style chips: describe the problem-to-clarity story — sites not ranking for commercially important searches, strategy-first diagnosis. Chips may express process/positioning labels, never invented statistics.

Second narrative split (image left, copy right) with floating chips: the four-stage process (01 Diagnose, 02 Prioritise, 03 Execute, 04 Improve) presented alongside medium imagery with lavender-tinted background accents.

Light FAQ band: flat illustration montage left, violet pill accordion stack right; first item expanded in dark text, remaining items as saturated violet pills with trailing chevrons. Content: honest SEO FAQs (scope, process, timelines framed without guarantees).

Photo-backed band: full-bleed office photograph darkened, white rounded cards and a dark accent quote card over the left half carrying the closing value proposition 'Ready to make organic search work harder for your business?' with pill CTA 'Talk to RankForge'. No invented testimonials — cards carry the value proposition and positioning statements.
Compact newsletter/lead-capture band with inline name and email fields and a violet pill submit action, feeding the central WAZIBIZ Form Service.

Dark conversion close: near-black full-width contact banner ('Let's talk about where search can take your business.' with consultation CTA linking toward the contact route), then a dense dark multi-column footer with navigation, contact email hello@rankforgekenya.example, Nairobi/Kenya location line and legal row.

imageSystem.photographyGrammar: Environmental business-context proof, not product display: candid collaborative workplace scenes for the darkened hero and testimonial backdrop; one portrait-orientation medium shot of a single person at a device inside a soft lavender blob mask for the about split; medium lightly-posed single-person shots with laptops/tablets for narrative splits; flat colorful illustration montage figures beside the FAQ and small square icon chips on service cards. Warm-neutral to slightly warm, moderate contrast, clean office backgrounds, restrained complexity, text-safe negative space where copy overlays imagery. Avoid: macro product shots, dramatic cinematic lighting, desaturated editorial fashion treatment, sterile studio backgrounds.

imageRoles.purpose: Full-bleed collaborative-office photograph for the hero, wide landscape, people working at laptops, cropped to support a dark violet overlay wash and left-weighted text mass.
Portrait-orientation medium shot of one practitioner at a device, displayed inside a soft lavender circular/blob mask in the about split.
Small square flat icon/illustration chips for service cards (REPEATABLE, one per card) — flat colorful vector-style marks, not photography.
Medium shot, lightly posed single person with laptop, clean light background, image right; hosts floating chip overlays.
Medium shot with tablet/device against clean or lavender-tinted background, image left; hosts floating chip overlays.
Full-bleed real-office photograph as the testimonial/value-prop band backdrop, darkened so overlaid cards remain readable.
Flat illustration montage figures beside the FAQ stack (square, flat colorful style, NOT photographic).

motionGrammar: Scroll-triggered reveal transitions on sections, cards and split imagery (substituting the reference's heavy parallax per Adaptation Contract 'mass'-level fidelity retained statically)
Floating metric-style chips in narrative splits receive slightly staggered reveal timing as the focal motion moment
Hero and testimonial backgrounds: subtle static depth cue (slight scale-in on reveal), no scroll-linked parallax
Violet pill buttons: 150ms background/shadow color transition on hover, visible focus ring, pressed state
FAQ accordion: 300ms expand/collapse with chevron rotation; first item open by default
Header: solid background transition on scroll; mobile menu slide/fade 200–300ms
All reveals respect prefers-reduced-motion: content appears without translation or scale
No structural scroll motion: no horizontal scroll, no section reordering; stable topology
responsiveContract: Breakpoints: ~1440 desktop reference, ~1024 intermediate, ~768 tablet, 375 mobile
All 12 homepage sections persist on mobile — single-column stacking, never content removal
Services collection rows (4-up, 2-up, 4-up) collapse to stacked single-column cards, each retaining icon chip and pill action
Split regions stack image above copy (about portrait scales within its lavender mask)
Centered nav strip collapses to compact mobile menu; pill CTA stays reachable; header compresses from ~143px
Full-bleed photo regions crop imagery (object-position toward subject/text-safe area) while preserving overlay composition
Logo/trust strip reduces from 5-up row to wrapped smaller set
No horizontal overflow at any breakpoint; form fields and accordions full-width on mobile
innerPageVocabulary: NARROW_NARRATIVE — centered narrow column for about-page philosophy text under an H2 badge heading

EDITORIAL_SPLIT — masked portrait or environmental image one side, dense bullets/principles other side (About principles: Commercial relevance, Technical clarity, Useful content, Continuous improvement)
STAGGERED_MEDIA — services detail pages alternating image/copy blocks per service
CARD_COLLECTION — reuse of the services card row pattern for service listing pages
PROCESS_SEQUENCE — four-step numbered sequence (Diagnose / Prioritise / Execute / Improve) with pill step markers
CONTACT_SPLIT — dark contact banner + form fields (Name, Company, Email, Phone, Website, help-topic select, Message) beside contact details
antiFallbackRules: Do not compress the ~1.86-viewport services collection into a single uniform 3-up card grid — preserve the 4/2/4 asymmetric row structure
Do not replace the dark violet photographic hero with a flat color or gradient-only hero
Do not swap pill buttons for square/rectangular buttons — the pill system with trailing glyphs is identity-defining
Do not center every heading — H2s are badge-preceded and predominantly left-aligned except the trust-strip heading
Do not replace the lavender blob mask on the about portrait with a plain rectangle
Do not use generic fade-up on every section uniformly — stagger cards and chips
Do not lighten the dark contact banner / footer close — the near-black conversion close is part of the silhouette
Do not add glassmorphism, mesh gradients or neon effects absent from the reference
Do not invent testimonials, metrics, client logos, rankings or results — constrained content replaces reference proof elements
accessibilityAdaptations: All violet-on-white pill text meets contrast (white text on #8E2DE2/#4E2DSA fills; dark text alternative if contrast fails)
Dark hero overlay ensures headline/CTA contrast ≥ 4.5:1 against the photographic wash
Visible focus rings on all pills, nav links, accordion triggers and form fields
Accordion uses semantic button + aria-expanded; form fields have persistent labels
prefers-reduced-motion disables reveals, staggering and scale effects
Mobile body type ≥ 16px; tap targets ≥ 44px including pill buttons and accordion rows
Decorative photos and illustration montages are aria-hidden; alt text only for meaningful imagery
declaredLimitations: Heavy parallax choreography replaced with static-preserving scroll reveals per accepted Adaptation Contract (heavy_parallax unsupported)
Exact reference fonts assumed Figtree/Montserrat/Poppins; closest legal equivalents used if licensing/unavailability blocks exact families
Motion timing values unmeasured in reference — durations are best-practice estimates (150/300/500ms)
Trusted-logos strip cannot contain real client logos per business facts; presented as reduced-weight capability/credential line unless the client supplies marks
Floating metric chips render as label/status chips only — no quantitative claims permitted
Reference content, branding and photography are design evidence only and are never copied
